questions.label: Pulse not palpable
questions.questionInfo: If checked Yes, the pulse rate box is hidden.

questions.label: Pulse Rate (PR) (bpm)
questions.questionInfo: Beats per minute. Whole numbers only.

questions.label: If irregular, type of irregular rhythm
Respiratory Rate (RR) (breaths/min)
questions.questionInfo: Breaths per minute. Whole numbers only.

questions.label: Weight (kg)
questions.questionInfo: Use kilograms for age ≥ 30 days (2 decimals allowed).

questions.label: Weight (g) - infants under 30 days
questions.questionInfo: Use grams for infants under 30 days (no decimals).

questions.label: Weight for Height/Length (WFH/L) z-score
questions.questionInfo: Typical range -3 to 3 (extended -5 to 5 under discussion).

questions.label: Body Mass Index (BMI) (kg/m²)
questions.questionInfo: Auto-calculated from Weight (kg) and Height (rounded to 1 decimal). Note: unit is kg/m².

answers.label: Absent breath sounds despite respiratory effort
Inability to feed due to respiratory problems

Dehydration: Diarrhoea present
